analysis:
All three changed files are documentation (inference.md, model-registry.md, prefix-cache.md). No executable code, protocol, or key-handling changes are in the supplied evidence.

Changed security-relevant claims:
- model-registry.md lines 17-22: documents that ModelMediaPolicy.advertisesMedia keeps staged nemotron_h_omni checkpoints from advertising media support even when vision_config is present. This is a fail-closed, narrowing guard. It is relevant to the media-ingest surface (T-050, T-056) and to routing and advertisement honesty. The guard's implementation (ProviderCoreFoundation/ModelMediaPolicy.swift) was not supplied, so it is unverified.
- prefix-cache.md lines 295-306: documents that the recurrent checkpoint bank now also admits the plain unpublished Nemotron Super owner. A new alignsRecurrentCheckpointsToPrefillChunks mode captures checkpoints only at multiples of the prefill chunk. Relevant to T-041 (cross-tenant prefix-cache sharing and TTFT oracle, SEC-035). The documented reuse remains per-cacheSalt, which is coordinator-authored, and is described as a contiguous in-RAM bank. It adds no SSD tier, no on-disk artifact and no change to the TTL or lookup-tag derivation, so the T-041 at-rest posture is unchanged. Whether the Nemotron Super bank is covered by the T-041 account-scoped salt and by the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch depends on code not supplied (NemotronSuperLocalPrefixCache). The next pass should check that code if it is in the batch.
- inference.md head lines 25-171 (patch excerpt truncated; the head text supplied covers only lines 821 onward): adds the unregistered NemotronSuperLocalBridgeBuilder, which takes pretokenized text only and rejects media, tools, schemas and client prompt-cache keys. It is not registered and exposes no HTTP route. This documents new internal attack surface in code outside the supplied evidence. The visible text at 821-1366 shows only incidental edits (the media-discovery cross-reference at 890-891). It also repeats the existing MiMo and Qwen documentation, which is not new.

No threat-model assumption is invalidated by these docs. Because the claims are documentation-only and the source is not in scope, no finding is warranted. Source-level verification of the Nemotron Super bridge and prefix-cache salt scoping is deferred to code review.
